about: Replies inside an open P1 water-leak case. vendor → accepted | declined | on_site | mitigated | completed | delayed. neighbor (the unit above, asked to check for water) → no_leak | leak_found | possible_leak. resident (asked 'is water still coming in? 1 = stopped, 2 = still coming in') → stopped | still_leaking | thanks | forward (a person should see it) | log (nothing to act on).

cases.text: Yes we can take it, ETA 40 min
on my way, 25 minutes
Sorry can't tonight, all techs are out
On site now
Arrived, heading up to the unit
Water is shut off and the leak is stopped. Burst supply line under the 3B vanity. Replaced the line. Drywall in 2B needs to be cut out and replaced, estimate $1,150.
All done, replaced the wax ring on the toilet, no further work needed
Running about 30 min behind, still coming
we're not able to get there until tomorrow morning, is that ok?
cases.why: for a P1, 'tomorrow' is a decline — the ladder must move on

cases.text: Capped the line, leak is stopped for now. Will need to come back to replace the valve.
No leak here, everything is dry
Checked under the sinks and around the toilet, nothing
Yes there's water on the bathroom floor!
Found a puddle under the water heater
Hmm, the floor by my bathroom vanity feels a little damp? Not sure if that's new.
I think the cabinet under the sink might be wet but I'm not home until tomorrow
all good up here
there's a little water around the base of the toilet, maybe from my shower earlier?
It stopped, thank you!
still coming in, it's getting worse
thanks!
not sure, the carpet still feels wet
cases.why: hedged — a person decides whether it's still leaking

cases.text: Can someone call me? I need to talk to a person
Will I need to move out while they fix the ceiling?
ok

cases.why: a new issue a person should see
